sources.locator: United States Courts of Appeal / Federal Reporter; United States District Courts / Federal Supplement
sources.supports: Explicit F., F.2d, F.3d mapping to Federal Reporter with United States appellate coverage; F. Supp. and later series map to Federal Supplement with United States district-court coverage.
sources.limitations: Use stable title and reporter-level coverage only; historical first-series dates and other dynamic statements on this guide were not adopted.
